senses.gloss: m. (עָכַל); pl. עִיכּוֹלִין, עִכּ׳ things attacked by fire, half-burned pieces which bounded off the altar.
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 83b:6">Zeb. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>עִיכּוֹלֵי עולה</he> pieces of a burnt-offering; <he>עיכולי קטורת</he> of frankincense; <cite ref="Yoma 45b:2">Yoma 45ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 90a:15">Ḥull. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ בשר</he> pieces of flesh; <he>ע׳ גידים ועצמות</he> of sinews and bones.
